entities.name: Jirō Shirasu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jirō Shirasu  was a Japanese businessman and official. He was a confidant of Prime Minister Shigeru Yoshida and served as a liaison between Japanese cabinet and the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers during the American occupation of Japan.
